posts.title: Lachha paratha, layer by layer
posts.caption:
Monday ki subah, lachha paratha.

All those flaky layers need even heat and a surface that lets go. The Tawaana tawa gives you both.

A little ghee, medium flame, and it lifts right off with a wooden spatula.

Super lightweight iron with a PFOA-free granite non-stick coating. tawaana.com

posts.title: Built flat, stays flat
posts.caption:
A warped pan wobbles, and food cooks unevenly.

The Tawaana hot plate is built not to warp on high flame, so it sits level on the burner and gives even, steady heat across the whole surface.

Perfect for tikka, boti and grills.

Available in 12", 13" and 14". tawaana.com

posts.title: 3 ideas for leftover roti
posts.caption:
Kal ki roti bachi hai? Don't throw it out.

1. Anda roti roll on the tawa
2. Masala roti chips in the fry pan
3. Malai boti wrap from the hot plate

A few drops of oil and a wooden spatula is all you need.

Save this for tomorrow's lunch. tawaana.com
